title: Business Man
desc: An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.

title: Thunichal
desc: A young man falls in love with a woman. However, when he is unable to get her, his obsession takes a dark and murderous turn.

title: Ethirum Puthirum
desc: Kanna, an honest district collector, is tasked with housing the brother of a renowned terrorist before a negotiation. However, things become complex when the collector is accused of terrorist ties.

title: Kummi Pattu
desc: Consumed by extreme rage, a young man rapes his step-brother's fiancée. However, she decides to forgive him and supports him overcoming his troubles.

title: Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu
desc: Having never won a tournament, a team of kabaddi players are ridiculed by their villagers. Their redemption finally arrives while playing in Madurai, for which they pay a heavy price.
